message.content:
1: play | A player in a white jersey stands over the ball near the penalty area, preparing for a free kick.
2: play | The player in white remains stationary, focusing on his run-up for the free kick.
3: play | The player in white begins to take a few steps back to start his approach.
4: play | The player in white starts his run-up towards the ball for the free kick.
5: play | The player in white continues his run-up, closing in on the ball.
6: play | The player strikes the ball, sending it toward the goal as the defensive wall jumps.
7: play | The ball is in mid-air, flying past the defensive wall and toward the goal.
8: play | The camera follows the ball's trajectory as it heads into the net for a goal.
9: play | A wide shot shows players reacting immediately after the goal is scored.
10: play | Players from the scoring team begin to turn and move toward each other.
11: play | The scoring team's players start to gather in a group near the center of the pitch.
12: play | More players converge as the celebration begins to take shape on the field.
13: celebration | The players are now huddled together in a clear group celebration of the goal.
14: celebration | The group of celebrating players remains tightly packed together on the pitch.
15: celebration | The players continue their celebration, with some jumping and embracing.
16: celebration | The celebration carries on with players congratulating one another.
17: closeup | A tight shot focuses on two players interacting closely during the aftermath.
18: closeup | The camera follows a player in a pink jersey running across the frame.
19: closeup | A close-up tracks the same player in pink continuing to run on the field.
20: graphics | A large broadcast graphic wipe with a red and white logo covers the screen.
